caption: Figure 3: Among arXiv papers each month that mention common deep learning frameworks, percentage of them that mention PyTorch.
description:
## Description

This line graph depicts the percentage of arXiv papers mentioning common deep learning frameworks each month, with a focus on PyTorch. The graph spans from July 2017 to January 2019. The series for PyTorch starts at around 0% in July 2017 and rises steadily, reaching approximately 40% by January 2019. The series for other frameworks remains relatively stable, showing minor fluctuations but no significant upward or downward trends.

## Text in figure

The graph shows the percentage of arXiv papers mentioning common deep learning frameworks each month, focusing on PyTorch. The x-axis represents the months from July 2017 to January 2019. The y-axis represents the percentage of papers mentioning the frameworks. The series for PyTorch starts at 0% in July 2017 and increases to approximately 40% by January 2019. The series for other frameworks remains relatively stable throughout the period.
